name: Wow Elements Addons for Elementor
author: Wow Elements

sections.description:
Wow Elements Addons for Elementor is a comprehensive plugin designed to supercharge your Elementor page builder with powerful, easy-to-use widgets. Perfect for bloggers, marketers, business owners, and WooCommerce users who want to create stunning, fully customized websites.

Why Wow Elements?

  • 120+ Free & Pro widgets to cover common UI patterns
  • Mobile-first, responsive controls
  • WooCommerce widgets(grids, carousels, pricing, reviews)
  • Smooth Animations & Effects
  • Easy Drag & Drop Interface
  • Modern Perfect Design Control
  • Lightweight assets and performance-oriented defaults
  • Pixel-perfect design options
  • Regular updates and friendly support

🎯 **FREE WIDGETS COLLECTION**

📋 Content & Layout Widgets

  • Accordion – Collapsible content sections with smooth animations and customizable styling
  • Content Switcher – Tabbed content interface to organize and display multiple sections
  • Modal – Popup modals with various trigger options and content sources
  • Document Viewer – Embed and display documents directly on your website

🎨 Interactive & Animation Widgets

  • Counter – Animated counters with various styles and effects
  • Progress Bar – Customizable progress bars with animations
  • Animated Heading – Eye-catching animated text headings
  • Animated Link – Eye-catching animated links with unique hover effects and transitions
  • Audio Player – Custom audio player with playlist support
  • Flip Box – 3D flip animations to reveal content on hover
  • Animated Box – Interactive content boxes with hover effects
  • Hover Video – Videos that play on hover
  • Image Expand – Expandable images with zoom and lightbox functionality
  • Image Stack – Layered image effects with depth and perspective
  • Interactive Card – Interactive card layouts with hover effects and animations
  • Interactive Links – Eye-catching links with unique hover effects and transitions
  • Interactive Tabs – Dynamic tabbed content with smooth transitions
  • Lottie Image – Add beautiful Lottie animations to your site
  • Marquee – Scrolling text or content with smooth animations
  • Reading Progress – Show reading progress indicator
  • SVG Blob – Create beautiful animated SVG blob shapes

🖼️ Gallery & Media Widgets

  • Image Gallery – Advanced gallery with multiple layouts and filtering
  • Creative Gallery – Stylish image galleries with modern layouts and lightbox support
  • Image Accordion – Accordion-style image galleries with smooth transitions
  • Image Compare – Before/after image comparison slider
  • Lightbox – Image lightbox with gallery support and smooth transitions
  • Slider – Responsive content slider with multiple transition effects
  • Video Gallery – Display and organize video collections

🚗 Carousel & Slider Widgets

  • Brand Carousel – Smooth sliding carousel to showcase brand logos and partners
  • Logo Carousel – Smooth sliding carousel for logo displays
  • Static Carousel – Smooth, non-sliding carousels to showcase content
  • Product Carousel – WooCommerce product carousel with smooth sliding

📊 Grid & Layout Widgets

  • Brand Grid – Grid layout to display brand logos and partner companies
  • Logo Grid – Grid layout for displaying client or partner logos
  • Product Grid – WooCommerce product grid with filtering and sorting
  • Review Card Grid – Grid layout for displaying customer testimonials

🎯 Button & Navigation Widgets

  • Creative Button – Eye-catching buttons with unique hover effects and animations
  • Dual Button – Two-button layouts with various styling options and effects
  • Image Hotspot – Highlight important text with marker effects
  • Mobile Menu – Responsive, customizable menus for mobile views
  • Nav Menu – Advanced navigation bar with dropdown support
  • Offcanvas – Off-canvas sidebar and menu system
  • Scroll Button – Smooth scroll-to-top buttons with customizable styling
  • Scroll Navigation – Navigation that changes based on scroll position
  • Table of Content – Automatic table of contents generator
  • Vertical Menu – Vertical navigation menu with dropdown support

📝 Content & Text Widgets

  • Heading Titles – Advanced heading with rich typography options
  • Icon Box – Feature boxes with icons and custom styling
  • Crewative List – Beautifully styled lists with custom icons
  • Stacker – Stackable content blocks with hover effects
  • Static Grid Tab – Grid-based tabbed content layout

🎪 Special Effects Widgets

  • Circle Menu – Circular menu layout with smooth hover animations
  • Circle Info – Circular information displays with animated content presentation
  • Progress Pie – Circular progress indicators with animated displays
  • Step Flow – Step-by-step process visualization with progress indicators

📈 Business & E-commerce Widgets

  • Business Hours – Display business operating hours with customizable styling
  • Comparison List – Side-by-side comparison tables for products or services
  • Google Reviews – Display Google business reviews with ratings
  • Member – Team member profiles with social links
  • Price List – Display pricing information in organized list format
  • Price Table – Responsive pricing tables with comparison features
  • Review Card Carousel – Customer review carousel with star ratings
  • Social Proof – Display testimonials and trust badges

🎨 Content Enhancement Widgets

  • Featured Box – Highlight important content with customizable featured boxes
  • Call Out – Highlight important information with attention-grabbing call-out boxes
  • Countdown – Timer widget for events, sales, or product launches
  • Total Count – Animated counters for statistics and achievements

🗺️ Maps & Location Widgets

  • Open Street Map – Interactive OpenStreetMap integration

🔍 Utility Widgets

  • Search – Advanced search functionality with customizable styling
  • Social Share – Social media sharing buttons with various platforms
  • Age Gate – Age verification popup to restrict content based on user age requirements
  • Barcode – Generate scannable barcodes in multiple formats with customizable styling

🚀 **PRO WIDGETS COLLECTION**

📝 Post & Content Widgets

  • Post Grid – Beautiful grid layout for displaying blog posts with filtering options
  • Post List – Clean list layout for blog posts with customizable styling
  • Post Carousel – Smooth carousel for showcasing blog posts
  • Post Slider – Advanced slider for blog posts with multiple layouts
  • Post Gallery – Gallery layout for blog posts with lightbox support
  • Post List Carousel – Carousel layout for post lists
  • Post Featured List – Featured posts list with highlighted content
  • Post Hover List – Interactive hover effects for post lists
  • Post Animated Box – Animated box effects for individual posts
  • Post Tiny List – Compact list layout for posts
  • Post Timeline – Timeline layout for blog posts
  • Post Vertical Timeline – Vertical timeline for posts
  • Post Horizontal Timeline – Horizontal timeline layout
  • Post Stories Slider – Stories-style slider for posts
  • Post Video Slider – Video-focused slider for posts

🎬 Advanced Content Widgets

  • Animated Post List – Animated list layout for posts
  • Author – Author information and profile display
  • Category Carousel – Carousel for category displays
  • Tag Cloud – Interactive tag cloud display
  • Recent Comments – Display recent comments with styling
  • News Ticker – Scrolling news ticker widget
  • Checkerboard – Checkerboard layout for content

🎯 Remote Controls

  • Remote Arrows – Control sliders or carousels using external arrow navigation
  • Remote Pagination – Add external pagination controls to synced sliders
  • Remote Navigation – Use custom elements to navigate between sections or widgets
  • Remote Thumbs – Thumbnail-based navigation for synced sliders or galleries

🌀 Dynamic Loop Builder

  • Dynamic Grid – Display posts, products, or content in a responsive grid layout
  • Dynamic Carousel – Show dynamic content in a customizable carousel slider
  • Dynamic Accordion – Expandable/collapsible accordion sections with dynamic data
  • Dynamic Tabs – Switchable tabbed content powered by dynamic sources

More widgets and features are coming soon…
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

e.g.

  1. Upload wow-elements-addons-for-elementor folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Start using it by going to the Elementor editor.
sections.faq:
Does your plugin support all WordPress themes?

  • Yes, the Wow Elements Addons for Elementor is compatible and supports all WordPress themes including popular free and premium Elementor themes.

What do I need to use the plugin?

  • Just install Wow Elements Addons for Elementor along with Elementor page builder; that’s all. Our plugin will provide you with all essential widgets to help you create your blogging site in minutes.

Do you provide tutorials on the plugin?

  • Of course, we provide detailed documentation and video to support our users with thorough guidelines for our plugins and widgets.

How do I get a solution for any issue?

  • Just contact us and we will follow up within 24 hours with our expert technical team.

How should I get updates and support

  • When we release a update version, then automatically you will get a notification on WordPress plugin manager, so you can update from there. Thereafter you want to update manually just knock us, we will send you update version via mail.
